name: Chili-Style Beef Soup with Pinto Beans, Bell Pepper, Celery & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 red bell peppers
4 sticks celery
1 lime
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; trim and thinly slice celery. Add both to the bowl with the green onion.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the pot is hot, add beef and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the beef is done, add veggies and salt to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, add spices to the pot and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp chili powder
4 tsp cumin, ground
2 tsp paprika
salt
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp coriander, ground
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add beans, water, and tomato sauce to the pot; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, 12-15 minutes.
While the soup simmers, cut lime into wedges.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh.
Divide soup between bowls and top with avocado. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over top. Enjoy!
